definitions.explanation: Providing for one's own needs without relying on outside help, especially in terms of food production and economic independence.

examples.japanese: {自給自足|じきゅうじそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}って→移る：01232_utsuru⟧{自給自足|じきゅうじそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I moved to the countryside and am aiming for self-sufficiency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧{自給自足|じきゅうじそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賄|まかな}っていた→賄う：07873_makanau⟧。
examples.english: In farming villages long ago, people produced almost all the food they ate themselves.

notes:
{自給自足|じきゅうじそく} is a four-character compound: {自|じ} (self) + {給|きゅう} (supply) + {自|じ} (self) + ⟦{足|そく}→足：00992_soku⟧ (suffice).

- {自給自足|じきゅうじそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: self-sufficient lifestyle
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧{自給自足|じきゅうじそく}: food self-sufficiency

Frequently appears in discussions about food security (⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧), sustainable living, and the trend of urban residents moving to rural areas to grow their own food.
